# void_cart_surface_pocket { #mofography.pocket_framework_env.void_cart_surface_pocket }

```python
pocket_framework_env.void_cart_surface_pocket(
    regions_pbc,
    dgrid,
    rep,
    shape,
    atoms,
    *,
    surface_dgrid_max=SURFACE_DGRID_MAX_A,
    mask_thickness=0.05,
    max_samples=SURFACE_MAX_SAMPLES,
)
```

Surface void voxels of pocket ``rep`` (small dgrid → close to VDW surface).



## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

surface_voxels_cart : (N, 3) Cartesian, MIC-wrapped around pocket maximum
peak_cart : (3,) Cartesian position of the dgrid maximum (physical cage centre)
